01 / RESEARCH

A few open questions.

How does intelligence transfer between brains, people, and machines?

Cross-individual connectome alignment

in progress

FlyWire · Prof. Wayne Hayes, UC Irvine
Princeton Neuroscience Institute

Aligning fly-brain networks with SANA, alongside NBLAST comparisons, to investigate which neurons have one-to-one counterparts across individuals and which lack a unique correspondence.

connectomics / graph alignment / neuroscience

Learning across users

co-author

sEMG hand-gesture classification

Benchmarked three classifier families using 21 feature types and 128 channels from 18 participants. Evaluated cross-user generalization through 378 random-forest fits and leave-one-subject-out validation.

research code ↗

Irontrace ↗

01

Cost-aware ML for hydraulic inspection

A pump-leakage classifier built on 70 features, 14 sensors, and 2,205 recorded cycles. Budget-aware sensor selection paired with a FastAPI, React, and SQLite inspection console.

TabPFN / Python / FastAPI / React

DroneLab ↗

02

AI training & evaluation for drone control

A physics-based environment for training drone-control policies. Combines Rapier dynamics with TensorFlow.js behavior cloning, reproducible flight episodes, and evaluation against scripted and random controllers.

Rapier / TensorFlow.js / simulation

Axiom

Quantitative research & backtesting

An Electron research application combining market data, signal scoring, ML outcome tracking, and AI-assisted research. Developing an XGBoost ranking pipeline with walk-forward validation and transaction-cost modeling.

03 / ABOUT

A little more human.

A student, builder, and perpetually curious person in Katy, Texas.

I'm at Seven Lakes High School, graduating in 2028. My interests sit somewhere between machine learning, autonomous systems, neuroscience, and biomedical engineering.

I like taking a question far enough that it becomes something I can test, build, or break. Sometimes that's a model. Sometimes it's a circuit, a drone, or a transforming trebuchet.

Building beyond software

On RoboSpartans, FRC 4639 ↗, I work on electrical layouts, power distribution, CAN wiring, sensors, and cable routing.

My teams placed 3rd globally in Destination Imagination's 2024 Engineering Challenge and won Grand Champion in the Pumps & Pipes ChemE Car challenge.
